I believe he has put together a team of developers to fork dogecoin and create X coin (https://t.co/UVtpWfXWrk)

For those that don’t know, a fork of a crypto indicates that there's been a change in or a diversion to the protocol. https://t.co/Wc9QV8USqT

Will a fork of Doge have any impact on the price of Dogecoin itself? I think it’s important for Dogecoin hodlers to understand the implications of a potential fork and what it means for their investment.
